title: Fake Alignment: Are LLMs Really Aligned Well?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion or faith. The benchmark measures 'fake alignment' across general safety categories such as Fairness (gender, race, sexual orientation), Individual Harm, Legality, Privacy, and Civic Virtue.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
